name: Off-by-One Loop Boundary in Array Search
description: Linear search iterates past array end, raising IndexError on final loop index.

scripted_response.root_cause: Loop upper bound uses range(len(items) + 1), accessing out-of-bounds index.
scripted_response.expected_behavior: find_element returns element index or -1 without raising IndexError.
scripted_response.unified_diff:
--- a/src/search.py
+++ b/src/search.py
@@ -2,3 +2,3 @@
 def find_element(items, target):
-    for i in range(len(items) + 1):
+    for i in range(len(items)):
         if items[i] == target:
